development_basis: A NumPy pilot-power proposal was explored on the existing development probes before freezing these native variants. This is not an untouched holdout.
scope: CFO-invariant folded pilot-power timing proposal, followed by blind full-band CFO acquisition and full-20ms FP64 fractional GLRT confirmation
algorithm_changes: Coarse search is normalized circular correlation of folded IQ power with Qin pilot-template power; it uses all available frames and has no CFO bank.
Proposed epochs are refined locally, followed by blind CFO search across the supported band.
FAST_FINE_FFT uses 4096/8192-point transforms and 610.3515625 Hz aligned bins inside the CFO bounds; it does not mislabel FFT bins as 500 Hz.
Legacy acquire/verify ranking scores are omitted; proposals retain power-correlation order. Final exact/control fractional GLRT is still required.
This is a separately named experimental detector, not a replacement scientific oracle.
